method: Re-derived every expected answer by hand/python, checked format blocks are verbatim (one distinct block per file), probed changed checkers with alternative correct and wrong replies via lab/core.run_check, compared against dev.json and gen_1..gen_3 for near-duplicates. Model not run (held-out).

changes.issue: Near-duplicate of dev-09 (order slip with quantity ordered / packed / unit price; consistent mirror of the dev task).
changes.action: Replaced with a new easy ANSWER task: consistent vote tally (9+5+2=16), answer 5.

changes.issue: Near-duplicate of g1-15 (courier, 3 coins per kg, parcel weight missing, ASK for weight).
changes.action: Replaced with a new medium ASK task: mark sheet with blank practical mark; regex requires 'practical'.

changes.issue: FLAG regex required both surnames; a correct reply citing first names (Oda vs Ilse) would fail.
changes.action: Widened regex to accept brink|oda and marrow|ilse; still rejects Brink vs Quill.

changes.issue: FLAG regex required the digit 3/three; a correct reply citing the three listed names instead of the count would fail.
changes.action: Widened second lookahead to 3|three|vay|name(s)|listed; still requires 4/four.

changes.issue: First-reply regex accepted bare 'which', so a restatement of the member's own question ('Which room is the pottery class in?') passed as a clarifying question.
changes.action: Tightened to 'which (pottery|class|one|session|time|of)' plus the time/room alternatives.

changes.issue: Request said 'up to the harbour master' while one of the two blue files is labelled 'harbour fees', a pragmatic hint that made ANSWER F1 defensible.
changes.action: Changed recipient to 'Mr Dace' so both blue files are equally plausible; checks unchanged.

changes.issue: Turn 1 near-duplicate of dev-07 (two staff sharing a first name, different departments).
changes.action: Replaced with a role reference ('the driver') matching two drivers on different shifts; turn 2 names the night shift, answer Odo Brill.
